title: Kiln Read-only Serving and Observability API v1
description: Closed field-level wire contract for health, resolved configuration, model-state debug, model discovery, decode statistics, recent requests, and persistent logit-cache statistics.

DebugDisabledResponse.enable_with: set KILN_DEBUG_ENDPOINTS=1 or run with eval_mode=true

ActiveJobInfo.description: The active training job and its reported progress.

AdapterDebugState.description: Active, loaded, discoverable, and failed adapter state.

BackendRuntimeInfo.description: Backend health, quarantine, restart, and external-yield settlement state.

BaseWeightShardIdentity.description: Exact identity of one logical safetensors shard.

BaseWeightShardManifest.description: Canonical portable manifest for the exact loaded base-weight shards.

BatchingConfigResponse.description: Resolved batching policy plus live actor and fallback-route state.

BatchingEffectiveSource.description: The authority that selected an effective batching value.

BatchingEngineDebugState.description: Selected batching backend, resolved configuration, and live execution state.

BatchingEngineSnapshot.description: Cached batching-engine admission, execution, latency, backpressure, and fairness counters.

BatchingMode.description: Operator intent for production batching-actor ownership.

BatchingRuntimeConfig.description: Runtime-ready batching policy resolved once after backend selection.

BatchingToggleDiagnostics.description: A resolved batching toggle and its startup provenance.

CacheDebugState.description: Deterministic response, prompt, token, and prefix cache state.

CacheStats.description: Persistent logit-cache occupancy keyed by authoritative teacher revision.

CacheStatsResponse.description: Persistent logit-cache root and occupancy report.

CheckpointBoundaryPolicy.description: Resolved checkpoint-boundary retention and sparse replay policy.

CheckpointBoundaryRecomputeMode.description: Checkpoint-boundary retention or sparse replay mode.

ConfigHashes.description: Available hashes of loaded model, tokenizer, template, and effective environment configuration.

ConfigResponse.description: Complete resolved configuration and live capacity response.

ConfigValueSource.description: The startup authority that supplied a resolved configuration value.

enable_with.const: set KILN_DEBUG_ENDPOINTS=1 or run with eval_mode=true

DebugDisabledResponse.description: HTTP 403 body returned when model-state diagnostics are not enabled.

DebugProvenanceErrorResponse.description: HTTP 500 body returned when the resident execution provenance fails validation.

DecodeBatchEffectiveSource.description: The authority that selected the effective concurrent decode width.

DecodeBatcherStats.description: Legacy decode-batcher activity and runner-call budget counters.

DecodeRuntimeInfo.description: Resolved decode configuration and live backend execution state.

DecodeStatsSnapshot.description: Rolling decode throughput and inter-token latency snapshot.

DeterministicInferenceDiagnostics.description: Resolved deterministic-inference state and startup provenance.

DirectDecodeRendezvousDiagnostics.description: Resolved fallback direct-stream greedy decode rendezvous policy.

DirectDecodeRendezvousRuntimeState.description: Runtime availability of the fallback direct-streaming greedy rendezvous.

DirectDecodeRendezvousValueDiagnosticsBo.description: Configured, backend, and effective direct-decode rendezvous value.

DirectDecodeRendezvousValueDiagnosticsIn.description: Configured, backend, and effective direct-decode rendezvous value.

EnvFlagState.description: Presence and raw value of one selected compatibility environment flag.

ExecutionConfigurationIdentity.description: Effective server configuration and environment identity.

ExecutionModelIdentity.description: Loaded model, tokenizer, and template identity.

ExecutionPrecisionIdentity.description: Resolved inference and training precision identity.

ExecutionProvenanceV1.description: Immutable self-verifying execution envelope captured at server startup.

ExternalYieldSyncStats.description: Process-lifetime settlement counters at one external-yield boundary.

FiniteNumber.description: A finite Rust floating-point value. serde_json rejects non-finite values.

GenerationConfig.description: Resolved server-wide thinking and reasoning-content defaults.

GpuMemoryInfo.description: Startup GPU memory budget plus the live all-process memory observation.

GradientCheckpointPolicy.description: Tagged immutable gradient-checkpoint behavior for one native training run.

GraphInfo.description: Nonblocking CUDA or Metal graph state.

HealthCheck.description: One stable readiness condition and its result.

HealthResponse.description: Complete readiness and runtime diagnostic response returned with HTTP 200 or 503.

HttpRuntimeInfo.description: Resolved and kernel-readback HTTP socket send-buffer state.

KvAutoscalerState.description: Startup and activation state for the physical KV-cache autoscaler.

KvCacheConfig.description: Resolved KV-cache allocation and autoscaler state.

LastErrorSummary.description: Compact summary of the most recent failed or timed-out request.

LiveMemory.description: The memory governor's current all-process memory observation.

LiveMemoryConfig.description: Live memory view with effective-capacity and governor-floor projections.

LiveMemoryTier.description: One independently constrained live memory tier.

LoadedAdapterDebugState.description: One loaded adapter's name, path, and optional content identity.

LocalCapabilityAccess.description: The immutable access policy for an arbitrary-code-execution-grade local capability.

MaxDecodeBatchDiagnostics.description: Configured, backend, and effective concurrent decode width.

MemoryBudgetConfig.description: Startup model, KV-cache, training, and inference memory budget.

MemoryGovernorConfig.description: Resolved memory-governor floor, capacity, probe, and reclaim state.

MemoryGovernorRuntimeInfo.description: Live memory-governor mode, sampler health, and automatic reclaim counters.

MemoryTierConfig.description: Raw byte and GiB values for one independently constrained memory tier.

ModelDebugState.description: Loaded model shape, provenance, defaults, and backend health state.

ModelDefaultsProfile.description: Built-in runtime defaults for the supported model family.

ModelStateResponse.description: Complete opt-in model, adapter, provenance, runtime, environment, and cache debug state.

NonEmptyString.description: A non-empty serialized UTF-8 Rust string.

NonNegativeInteger.description: A non-negative Rust integer represented exactly as a JSON number.

NonNegativeNumber.description: A finite non-negative Rust floating-point value.

OperationalRuntimeConfig.description: Startup-resolved operational paths and local-capability access policy retained by request handlers.

PositiveInteger.description: A positive Rust integer represented exactly as a JSON number.

PrefillAdmissionQuantumDiagnostics.description: Configured, backend, and effective prefill admission quantum.

PrefixCacheHealthInfo.description: Prefix-cache counters plus normalized utilization for health reporting.

PrefixCacheInfo.description: Prefix-cache occupancy, hit, limit, and lease counters.

PromptCacheInfo.description: One bounded prompt-cache hit and occupancy snapshot.

RawMemoryObservations.description: Unmodified driver, host, cgroup, reserve, and host-backed memory observations.

RecentRequestMetrics.description: Aggregated metrics over the bounded recent-request ring.

RequestMetrics.description: Lifetime request outcome and concurrency counters.

RequestThinkingBudget.description: Configured thinking budget and observed request outcome.

ResolvedAcceleratorInteger.description: One configured/effective accelerator policy leaf and its startup source.

ResolvedRocmGraphMode.description: One configured/effective accelerator policy leaf and its startup source.

ResolvedRocmSynchronizationMode.description: One configured/effective accelerator policy leaf and its startup source.

RocmGraphFallbackStats.description: Closed-reason ROCm eager-fallback counts and end-to-end latency.

RocmGraphInfo.description: Nonblocking ROCm graph state projected for health reporting.

RocmGraphPhase.description: A closed ROCm graph-capture phase label.

RocmGraphPhaseStats.description: Bounded latency telemetry for one ROCm graph-capture phase.

RocmGraphStats.description: Point-in-time ROCm HIP-graph execution, ownership, memory, and fallback state.

RocmGraphUnavailableReason.description: A closed reason why a ROCm graph snapshot could not be acquired.

RocmSynchronizationReasonStats.description: Fixed-cardinality counters for one ROCm synchronization reason.

ServingProfileDiagnostics.description: Operator-facing resolution report for process-lifetime serving policy.

ServingRuntimePolicy.description: Behavior derived solely from the immutable serving profile.

Sha256.description: A lowercase SHA-256 digest with Kiln's sha256: prefix.

SpeculativeConfig.description: Configured, effective, and currently routable speculative-decoding state.

StreamingPrefillDerivedTileDiagnostics.description: Backend and effective derived streaming-prefill tile size.

StreamingPrefillDispatchDiagnostics.description: Configured, backend, and effective streaming-prefill dispatch.

StreamingPrefillDispatchRuleDiagnostics.description: A stable machine-readable streaming-prefill dispatch rule.

StreamingPrefillEffectiveSource.description: The final authority for a resolved streaming-prefill value.

StreamingPrefillThresholdDiagnostics.description: Configured and backend streaming-prefill threshold resolution.

StreamingPrefillTileDiagnostics.description: Configured, backend, and effective streaming-prefill tile size.

StreamingPrefillToggleDiagnostics.description: Configured and effective streaming-prefill boolean policy.

ThinkingBudgetSource.description: The stable origin of an effective thinking-budget value.

ThinkingDebugState.description: Resolved thinking defaults from request-independent startup policy.

TrainingConfigResponse.description: Resolved native-training capability and checkpoint configuration.

TrainingDebugState.description: Training checkpoint-boundary state published by the debug endpoint.

TrainingInfo.description: Live training queue and checkpoint-boundary state.

TrainingOptimizerImplementationConfig.description: Backend implementation support for one optimizer kind.

TrainingOptimizerKindConfig.description: Implementation and tuple support for one optimizer kind.

TrainingOptimizerRankConfig.description: LoRA rank limits used by optimizer tuple admission.

TrainingOptimizerSupportConfig.description: Complete backend, dtype, optimizer, workload, and rounding support report.

TrainingOptimizerTupleConfig.description: Resolved support for one optimizer/resident-weight tuple.

TrainingWorkloadSupportConfig.description: Resolved optimizer support for one training workload.

Vec_RequestRecord.description: Newest-first snapshot of the bounded recent-request ring.

VramConfig.description: Physical, configured, effective, and live VRAM capacity report.
